title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS, proficiency in C++, Java, or Python, and knowledge of data structures.
description: Work alongside world-class engineers on scalable core infrastructure and consumer-facing web/mobile applications.

title: Rhodes Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Outstanding young leaders aged 18-24 with a completed undergraduate degree.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with exceptional academic standing and demonstrated leadership ability.
description: Fully funded postgraduate scholarship program supporting exceptional international students to study at the University of Oxford.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to entry-level developers globally with strong web application fundamentals.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science or self-taught with portfolio; proficiency in React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS.
description: Build user interfaces across Ubuntu web properties and maintain core web infrastructure in a global distributed team.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or entry-level candidates with strong quantitative skills.
qualification: Bachelor's in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or Business Analytics.
description: Conduct exploratory data analysis, construct interactive visual dashboards, and deliver quantitative insights for business client engagements.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education.
qualification: Teams of students creating innovative software applications using Microsoft Azure technology.
description: Global technology competition encouraging student innovators to solve real-world industry problems using artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

title: Machine Learning Specialization
eligibility: Open to all students and professionals globally.
qualification: Basic Python knowledge and high school-level mathematics.
description: Comprehensive foundational program created by Andrew Ng covering supervised learning, neural networks, and machine learning best practices.
